You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: First, pick up the red_cube and place it into the cyan_zone. Once the red_cube is securely placed, pick up the green_cup and place it into the orange_zone. Success is achieved when both the red_cube is located in the cyan_zone and the green_cup is located in the orange_zone, with no objects remaining unplaced.
Goals: [{"object": "red_cube", "zone": "cyan_zone"}, {"object": "green_cup", "zone": "orange_zone"}]

{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_cube": {"kind": "cube", "center": [0.0473, 0.2403, 0.8199], "top_z": 0.8398, "height": 0.0398, "footprint_long": 0.0397, "footprint_short": 0.039, "long_axis_yaw": -0.124}, "green_cup": {"kind": "cup", "center": [-0.1105, 0.2116, 0.8353], "top_z": 0.8706, "height": 0.0706, "footprint_long": 0.0449, "footprint_short": 0.0446, "long_axis_yaw": -1.571}}, "zones": {"orange_zone": {"name": "orange_zone", "center": [-0.0948, -0.2212, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0576, 0.0576]}, "cyan_zone": {"name": "cyan_zone", "center": [-0.0093, 0.0595, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0576, 0.0595]}, "purple_zone": {"name": "purple_zone", "center": [0.0465, -0.106, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0576, 0.0576]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0796, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.198, -0.0004, 1.0796], "yaw": 1.527}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
Reply with JSON only:
{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
